Copilot: I'm here to help. Collect green commits and dodge the bugs!

Fly through the commit stream with arrow keys or WASD (or press/drag on the board). Green commits drift down; catch them before they pass. Blocker issue cards are solid walls: walk around them, but don't get crushed between one and a wall! Hold Shift (or double-click/double-tap and hold) to sprint; collecting commits refills stamina. Esc pauses. Grab golden committed secrets before their fuse runs out, or they explode into bugs! Catch a falling Copilot head and it follows Mona, absorbing one fatal hit (up to 3 stack) and granting 3 seconds of invulnerability. Rare powerup orbs give temporary boosts: 🛡️ GitHub Advanced Security, ☁️ Cloud Runners, 🧲 Dependabot, 🔧 Copilot Autofix, 🔍 Code Review, 📦 Actions Cache, 🔒 Branch Protection, 🚦 Merge Queue, 👻 Codespaces. Press Enter or Space to restart after game over.
